label: Private copy
body: Every change is made on a private copy of your site and tested before the preview reaches you.

label: You publish
body: News, events, team, jobs, copy and design changes within your brand. The people you choose put these live.

label: Toby checks
body: Code, tracking, cookies, forms, and contact or bank details come to Toby before they go live, usually the same day.

label: Seven-day undo
body: Any published change can be rolled back for seven days.
